offering_description.value: Designs, certifies and manufactures avionics such as flat panel flight displays, autothrottles, flight management systems and air data computers. Sells mainly retrofit and forward-fit solutions to aircraft OEMs, operators, MROs and military customers. Everything is engineered and built in-house in Exton, Pennsylvania.

quotes.quote: Innovative Aerosystems designs, engineers, manufactures, certifies, and supports advanced avionics solutions for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. From integrated flight decks and autopilots to autothrottles, flight management systems, mission computers, air data systems, displays, engine instrumentation, and navigation technologies, our scalable solutions are engineered to meet the unique requirements of every platform.

At Innovative Aerosystems, we deliver custom avionics systems designed for your specific aircraft requirements—whether you’re upgrading a legacy platform or outfitting new production. From our FAA-certified flat panel flight decks to our award-winning ThrustSense® Autothrottle, our systems are engineered for performance, precision, and agility—delivering modern solutions for today’s demanding flight environments. Every product we design is engineered, certified, and manufactured at our in-house facility in Exton, Pennsylvania.

primary_products.value: flat panel cockpit display systems; autothrottles; air data computers and ADAHRS; flight management systems; GPS sensor units

quotes.quote: Cockpit/IP® Flat Panel Display Systems – FAA/EASA certified for B757/B767/737 and other platforms. Upgrade your cockpit with minimal wiring changes and transformative capability.
ThrustSense® Autothrottle – Full-regime autothrottle with FADEC-like protection for King Air and PC-12 aircraft. Flying Magazine’s Editors’ Choice Award winner.

primary_services.value: avionics engineering and certification; lifecycle support

quotes.quote: As one of the few U.S.-based avionics manufacturers with vertically integrated engineering and production, we control every stage of development—from concept and certification to manufacturing and lifecycle support. This enables us to deliver tailored, mission-ready solutions with the quality, reliability, and responsiveness our customers depend on. Whether modernizing legacy aircraft or developing next-generation capabilities, Innovative Aerosystems provides the expertise, flexibility, and innovation to keep fleets flying safely, efficiently, and ready for the future.

Hundreds of aircraft are flying Innovative Aerosystems avionics, we specialize in retrofitting commercial, business, and military aircraft with advanced, value-driven solutions that reduce downtime and improve situational awareness. Our agile engineering team works directly with operators, MROs, and OEMs to deliver tailored solutions that meet certification standards while maintaining installation simplicity.
